newsitem.title: USA: Manchester Equipment faces suit - lawyers.
newsitem.headline: Manchester Equipment faces suit - lawyers.

text.p: A securities class action suit was filed in a New York District Court alleging Manchester Equipment Co Inc and certain of its officers and directors with violations of U.S. securities law, the plaintiff's lawyer said.
The lawyers said the suit was commenced by plaintiff Vincent Manguard on behalf of himself and other purchasers of Manchester common stock from November 26, 1996 through February 13, 1997.

The complaint charged Manchester and certain of its officers and directors with purported violations of the federal securities laws by making false and misleading statements and omissions connected with its initial public offering effective November 26, 1996, lawyers said.
Manchester Equipment was not immediately available to comment.

The company and certain officers also allegedly made false and misleading statements about product availability, inventory management controls and its purported ability to obtain in-demand products on a timely basis.
These statements allegedly served to inflate the market price of Manchester common stock, lawyers said.
The plaintiff was represented by the law firm of Bernstein Litowitz Berger & Grossmann LLP.
